precedence: INVALID when a known operand disproves discrimination, isolation, generated provenance, or the independence cut
EXPIRED when every structural operand is valid but any current invalidation coordinate differs from its attested value
UNKNOWN when structural operands do not disprove the act but a required current coordinate cannot be read
VALID only when every required operand passes, every coordinate is current, and at least one independence crossing is demonstrated

four_postulates.mece: PASS: a known attestation defect, a changed coordinate, an unreadable coordinate, or a fully satisfied current act exhausts the declared terminal layer under the stated precedence.
four_postulates.same_grain: PASS: every member types one attestation act over one instrument version, plane, searched population, and denominator grain.
four_postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: all members answer whether this local discrimination certificate may currently be relied upon; none types the observation's substantive result.
four_postulates.state_coherence: PASS: all members re-derive from the same controls, shared-failure-domain operands, crossings, and current invalidation coordinates; failure to re-attest cannot preserve VALID.

absence_semantics: There are no nullable certificate fields. Missing required evidence fails schema validation; unavailable current invalidation coordinates derive UNKNOWN rather than creating a null hole.
